seoDescription: Custom eco friendly stickers on recyclable paper, kraft or biodegradable film, with a plain guide to what each does at end of life. Free US shipping.

quickAnswer: Custom eco-friendly stickers are printed on recyclable paper, natural kraft paper or a biodegradable film instead of PVC vinyl, so the label can go through paper recycling or break down faster in the environment. They suit food, cosmetic and craft packaging, shipping boxes and brands that want the material to match the message. From $0.30 per sticker, 100 minimum, 5 to 7 business days production.

sections.h2: Which sticker is actually eco friendly? An honest sort of the options
sections.html:
Eco friendly means different things to different buyers, and a sticker cannot be all of them at once. A paper label can be recycled with the box it sits on. A biodegradable film breaks down faster than vinyl when it ends up in soil or landfill. Neither one is waterproof the way vinyl is, and that is the trade you are making. This page lays the options out so you choose with your eyes open rather than on a leaf icon.

It is also the materials page. If you have already settled on paper and want it cut to a logo outline with a kiss cut backing, the die cut paper sticker page covers borders, cut lines and the sheet layout for shaped paper stickers. Here the question is which stock, which finish and which adhesive, and where each one will and will not survive. One rule we hold to: we do not claim certifications we cannot show, so you will not find compostable or forestry marks on this page unless the material carries them.

sections.h2: Where paper and biodegradable stickers fail, so you can plan around it
sections.html:
Most complaints about eco labels come from putting them where one of the vinyl stickers in our main custom sticker catalog should have gone. These are the situations to avoid, or to ask us about before you commit.

  • Cold drinks and anything that sweats in a fridge: paper wrinkles and the print lifts within hours.
  • Outdoor use of any length. Paper lasts weeks; biodegradable film fades and lifts within a season.
  • Oily products like balms and salad dressings on uncoated paper, which stains through from the back.
  • Dishwashers and hand washing, which dissolve paper adhesives.
  • Rough or textured surfaces such as raw corrugated board, where paper adhesive has less tack than vinyl adhesive.

Within those limits, paper stickers are tougher than their reputation. A matte-coated kraft label on a soap box handles shipping, shelf life and the customer's bathroom shelf without trouble, and a biodegradable film label on a shampoo bottle survives the shower for the life of the bottle. The surface and the lifespan are the two questions; answer those and the stock chooses itself.

sections.h2: Choosing the right eco stock in four decisions
sections.html:
Buyers who come to us wanting the greenest option usually leave with one of three answers, and the route there is short.

  1. Will the label get wet? No: go to paper. Yes, occasionally: kraft or paper with a matte coat. Yes, regularly: biodegradable film.
  2. Does the look matter more than the texture? A bright white recyclable paper prints colors cleanly; kraft mutes everything and shows fiber, which some brands want and some do not.
  3. Will it be recycled with the package? If the package is cardboard or paper, a paper label keeps the whole thing in one recycling stream.
  4. Does it need to be written on? Uncoated paper and kraft take a pen; film needs a marker.

We print all three stocks from the same artwork, so if you cannot decide, a 100-piece run of each is a cheap way to test them on your actual product. For the longer reasoning behind each stock, including what biodegradable does and does not mean in a landfill, read our guide to eco-friendly sticker materials.

sections.h2: Finishes and looks that keep a paper label feeling natural
sections.html:
A heavy gloss laminate on a paper label is a plastic film and undoes much of the point. The finishes that suit eco stocks are lighter: an uncoated surface, a thin matte varnish for scuff resistance, or a gloss varnish for a little depth on white paper. Kraft takes white ink well, and a white logo on brown kraft has become the default look for soaps, candles, coffee and bakery boxes for a reason: it needs no color to look finished.

If you want a touch of shine without a plastic laminate, the honest route is a small separate seal rather than a coated label. A 1-inch gold accent from our custom metallic sticker range on a kraft box gives the premium cue while the main label stays recyclable paper. Spot UV on paper is available too, and uses far less coating than a full laminate.

sections.h2: Ordering eco friendly labels: sizes, counts and timing
sections.html:
All three eco stocks cut from 0.5 inch up to 24 x 36 inches, as individual pieces, kiss cut sheets or rolls for a dispenser. Food and cosmetic labels cluster between 1.5 and 4 inches; shipping box labels run 3 x 5 or 4 x 6 inches. Minimum is 100 per design and pricing starts at $0.30 per sticker, with paper stocks usually at the lower end of the range because the material costs less than film.

Send artwork as PDF, AI, EPS, SVG or a 300 dpi PNG or JPG. A proof comes within a business day, printing takes 5 to 7 business days after you approve it, and FedEx delivery in the United States is free. faqs.a: Paper and kraft stickers are not; they wrinkle and lift when wet, so keep them on dry packaging. Biodegradable film resists moisture well enough for shampoo bottles, fridge products and hand washing, but it is not rated for years outdoors the way laminated vinyl is.

We do not claim compostable certification. The biodegradable film is a PVC-free, bio-based stock that breaks down far faster than vinyl in soil or landfill. Paper and kraft stickers can go in paper recycling with the box. If you need a certified compostable label for a specific program, tell us and we will say plainly whether we can meet it.

faqs.q: Can I recycle a kraft paper sticker with the cardboard box?
faqs.a: Yes. Kraft and recyclable white paper stickers are paper face stock with a water-based adhesive, which paper mills handle in the normal recycling stream. Keep the label unlaminated, since a plastic laminate turns a recyclable label into a mixed-material one.

faqs.q: Which eco friendly label works on a fridge-stored food product?
faqs.a: Biodegradable film. Condensation ruins paper within hours, while the film stays flat and the print stays put through the product's shelf life. For a jar that lives in a dry pantry, matte-coated kraft or recyclable paper is cheaper and looks more natural.

faqs.q: Do biodegradable paper stickers print in full color?
faqs.a: Yes. White recyclable paper prints CMYK and Pantone colors cleanly, close to what you see on coated paper. Kraft mutes colors because the brown fiber shows through, so on kraft we recommend dark inks and white ink for logos rather than pale pastels.

faqs.q: Can eco safe stickers be used on soap wrappers and candle jars?
faqs.a: They are the most common use. A matte-coated kraft or paper label on a soap box or candle lid handles shipping and shelf life without trouble. For soap that sits in a wet bathroom unwrapped, label the outer box rather than the bar, or move to biodegradable film.

faqs.q: How long do eco friendly stickers last outdoors?
faqs.a: Not long, and we would rather say so than sell you the wrong thing. Paper lasts a few weeks in weather. Biodegradable film fades and lifts over a season. For a sign, a car or a cooler that lives outside, laminated vinyl is the right product even though it is not recyclable.

faqs.q: Can I write on a kraft paper sticker?
faqs.a: Yes, uncoated kraft and uncoated white paper take ballpoint, pencil and marker, which makes them ideal for batch dates, scent names and handwritten thank-you labels. A matte varnish still takes a permanent marker. Gloss varnish and film need a marker and dry more slowly.

faqs.q: Is the adhesive on eco friendly labels also eco friendly?
faqs.a: The adhesive on paper and kraft stocks is a water-based acrylic that does not interfere with paper recycling, and it comes in permanent and removable versions. We do not describe it as compostable. The biodegradable film uses a compatible adhesive chosen so the label behaves as one material.

faqs.q: What is the minimum order for custom eco friendly stickers?
faqs.a: 100 stickers per design, priced from $0.30 each with free FedEx delivery in the United States. Paper stocks usually sit at the low end of the price range. Mixed orders are fine: 100 kraft, 100 white paper and 100 biodegradable film from the same art is a common first order.

faqs.q: Will oily products stain through a paper label?
faqs.a: Uncoated paper will show oil from balms, dressings and bath oils as a dark patch from the back within a few days. A matte varnish slows it down but does not stop it. For anything oily, use biodegradable film, or put the label on an outer box that stays dry.

faqs.q: Can eco friendly stickers be die cut to a custom shape?
faqs.a: Yes. All three stocks cut cleanly to any outline, as individual pieces, kiss cut sheets or rolls. Paper has a slightly softer edge than film on very fine points, so we suggest rounding sharp corners on paper shapes. The die cut paper sticker page goes into the shape details.
